scope: Port Motorola moto_sched (canoe: MUTEX/RWSEM inherit, MDPF) on android18-7.3 with sched_walt and proxy execution
core_hooks_restored: rvh pr_set_vma_name_bypass (7.3 moved PR_SET_VMA naming into set_anon_vma_name)
percpu_rwsem_down_read/up_write, rvh percpu_rwsem_wait_complete, record_pcpu_rwsem_starttime (out-of-line wrapper as 6.12)
rwsem_add_waiter_pos (7.3 waiter ring; new head takes over handoff as 6.12)
lock_order_fix: 6.12 called mutex_wait_start/rwsem_wake/rwsem_wake_finish under wait_lock; moto_sched takes the owner rq lock there, and 7.3 proxy execution takes wait_lock under rq locks (find_proxy_task), so the calls run right after wait_lock is released (once per slowpath).
module_fixes: resched_task(): running = task_current_donor() (proxy exec); 6.12 task_current() made put_prev_task warn and corrupted CFS (Oops) on the first inheritance test
mutex/rwsem reordering ported to position hooks
WALT data via android_task_vendor_data() instead of android_vendor_data1
rwsem_waiter/owner flags to 7.3 layout; trace paths; __task_rq_unlock(p); rwsem hooks in dtask.h
walt_fix: walt_init re-reads the root domain after rebuild_sched_domains (7.3 installs a new rd); stale rd caused an intermittent false WALT_BUG panic (seen 2 times before the fix)

extras: dmesg scan for WARNING/BUG/Oops/possible circular locking with lockdep on: none
